caption: The drawing depicts a single cylindrical jar with a slightly outward-flaring rim. The jar is rendered in dark brown, almost black hues, with a glossy finish that reflects light, creating bright white highlights on the upper and middle sections. There are subtle hints of a reddish-brown color around the base, where small spots of the underlying material are visible. The object sits centrally on a plain, off-white background, with no other objects or decorations in the composition. The detailed shading and reflections suggest a smooth, ceramic surface.
